text: Back to Kyiv? He caught sight of the Dnipro and turned towards the hangar all on his own. How do I tell him it’s a bit early for dinner?
You’ll see the hangar soon enough. There are fifteen helicopters over Podil and they take aim faster than the ones you met in Pechersk.
Then we will keep the greetings short. Cover Podil, then get him some dinner. We could use some ourselves.
